categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Has the Wallet label and modifies `src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp` and `test/functional/wallet_sendall.py`.
categories.rationale: Fixes a bug where `sendall` creates consensus-invalid transactions and leaves the wallet with negative balance accounting when duplicate inputs are passed. While not a permanent loss of funds, it resolves confusing failures and bad wallet state requiring manual abandonment.
